{{Quote|Senator Padmé, do you know who that was?''"<br />"''No.''"<br />"''Passel Argente's uncle! He's probably connected to the Separatists!|Sheltay Retrac and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Spy Girls" />}}
[[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente's]] '''uncle''' was a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He bribed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bezz Drexx]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on behalf of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in exchange for Drexx's loyalty. However, he was caught in the act while giving Drexx [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at a party hosted by the senator, and evidence of Drexx's corruption ended up in the hands of the Republic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|A word with you, Drexx&hellip; ''in private''.|The Koorivar|<ref name="Spy Girls" />}}
The uncle of<ref name="Spy Girls" /> [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="Passel Argente DB">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] was a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the Confederacy and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the individual bribed the Republic's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bezz Drexx]] with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for Drexx's loyalty to the Separatists. Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] suspected that Drexx had been receiving bribes, but he never obtained any proof.<ref name="Spy Girls" />

[[File:PasselUncleWithDrexx.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Argente's uncle at Drexx's party]]
The Koorivar delivered one such payment at a party hosted by Drexx on<ref name="Spy Girls" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In order to get the senator alone, he had to pull Drexx away from talking with Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and one of Senator Organa's [[Aide/Legends|aides]], [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|Sheltay Retrac]], both of whom were already wary of Drexx after discussing his suspicious wealth with Organa.<ref name="Spy Girls" />

The pair followed the Koorivar and senator, finding the Koorivar presenting Drexx with a case of [[Currency/Legends|money]]. The Separatist expressed his hope that it would be enough to keep Drexx loyal to the Confederacy, but the senator was more focused on a [[Narglatch AirTech/Legends|Narglatch]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that the money would allow him to buy. However, he then noticed Amidala spying on their conversation and called for his [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] to deal with her. She was able to escape with the evidence, which included a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] of the Koorivar bribing the senator that she brought to the Republic.<ref name="Spy Girls" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Drexx, I'm sure you'll find this payment adequate to ensure your ''continued loyalty'' to the Separatists.|The Koorivar|<ref name="Spy Girls" />}}
The Koorivar was willing to bribe high officials for the Separatist cause. He had light [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and light blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />

==Equipment==
Argente's uncle wore an orange<ref name="Spy Girls" /> [[Shimmerbird tongue robe/Legends|robe]] made of [[Shimmerbird/Legends|shimmerbird]] [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]].<ref name="db">{{DB|character|denariakee|Kee, Denaria}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Passel Argente's uncle appeared in "[[Spy Girls]]," a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], illustrated by [[Stewart McKenny]], and published in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7|seventh volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] graphic novel series<ref name="Spy Girls" /> on [[January 31]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/14-333/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-7|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7}}</ref>
